what: A 401 on any inventory call runs the session-ended flow once (sign-in with return to this page).

On a SUSPENDED or DELETING shop the button is disabled and the note under it carries the banner text ("This shop is suspended..." or "This shop is being closed...") as aria-description.
Without PLATFORM_CURRENCY the button is disabled with the note "Adding products isn't set up on this platform yet.".

Tab stays inside, Escape closes (nothing is saved), and focus returns to the "Add product" button.
Field "Title": required, trimmed, 1 to 200 characters (counted in code points); empty shows "Enter a title.", too long "Use at most 200 characters."; the input stops at 250.
Field "Brand": required, 1 to 100 characters; error "Enter a brand." / "Use at most 100 characters.".
Field "Category": required, 1 to 100 characters; error "Enter a category." / "Use at most 100 characters.".
Field "Description (optional)" (textarea, 3 rows): empty is allowed and then not sent; above 4,000 characters shows "Use at most 4000 characters."; saved trimmed.

Field "Price (EUR)" (label shows the platform currency): accepts digits with one point or comma, up to the currency's decimals, and sends integer minor units (24.50 sends priceMinor 2450; 24,5 sends 2450).

Price errors: empty "Enter a price."; "-5" "A price can't be negative."; "abc" or "1e3" "Enter a price like 24.50."; "1.234" "Use at most 2 decimal places."; 0 "A price must be more than zero."; above 10,000,000,000 minor "That price is too large.".

Price 0.01 (1 minor), 99999999.99 and 100000000.00 (the maximum 10,000,000,000 minor) are accepted and shown back exactly; 100000000.01 is refused; no rounding error (e.g. 0.1+0.2 style values 19.99, 1.005 refused).
With a zero-decimals currency (JPY) the price field asks for a whole number ("Enter a whole number." / "Use a whole number.") and sends the number as minor units; with KWD it allows 3 decimals.
Field "Stock" (starts at 0): whole number 0 to 1,000,000,000, else "Enter a whole number, 0 or more."; sent as quantity.
Stock 0, 1, 1000000000 accepted; 1000000001, -1, 1.5, "1e3", " 12 " (spaces, trimmed) handled as the field rules say.
